command: node --input-type=module -e import fs from "node:fs";import path from "node:path";import assert from "node:assert/strict";import {createHash} from "node:crypto";const p=path.resolve("quality/tasks.json");assert.equal(fs.realpathSync(p),p);const hash=()=>createHash("sha256").update(fs.readFileSync(p)).digest("hex"),before=hash(),fd=fs.openSync(p,"r+");let bytes;try{assert(fs.fstatSync(fd).isFile());bytes=fs.readSync(fd,Buffer.alloc(16),0,16,0);}finally{fs.closeSync(fd);}assert.equal(hash(),before);const ledger=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,"utf8"));assert.equal(ledger.tasks.find(t=>t.id==="CHATCRYPTO-BE").status,"IN_PROGRESS");console.log(JSON.stringify({ownedLedger:true,readBytes:bytes,noBytesWritten:true,hashUnchangedDuringProbe:true,ledgerSha256:before,status:"IN_PROGRESS"}));
